notes: TASK-424 found a pre-existing spend-ceiling unit mismatch (config micro-cents 1e5/USD vs recorded usd_micros 1e6/USD added to PromptSpend unconverted) — file a BUG at wrapup; shares reuse the shared spend_units helper so they stay consistent with the ceiling check.
TASK-424: a parent turn's own calls need CostAttribution::with_turn(turn_id) stamped where the prompt's egress is built — assigned to TASK-428.

TASK-427 follow-ups: provider_degraded/capability_dead_end may publish unstamped from a child; MCP/web lookups by a child are not charged to its share; run_prompt_turn is 233 lines total (227 before) / 125 code lines.

TASK-428 follow-ups: text-form (local-tier) call to a disabled agent gets the parser's generic message, not the agent.enabled hint; large agent results still pass the digest condenser; agent_child_consent_requested only for bus-published asks (addressed skill consent gets no label); agent roster entry (~1.6KB) rides in every prompt turn incl. local/degraded.
TASK-431 gaps: BR-14 says /help reports whether agent is available — CLI does not today; AC-18 runbook OUTSTANDING; REQ-623 Validation section to be written at wrapup.

TASK-430 follow-ups: spend ceiling binds at a tenth of configured dollars (REQ-588 unit bug, confirmed in a probe: $0.44 call reported as $4.40 vs $0.05 ceiling) — BUG at wrapup; a child that reroutes to local mid-run still names its starting remote route in the result; a timed-out child's blocking shell keeps running (output never reaches a model); BR-12 wording: since REQ-619 a user skill carries a ~-scoped identity, not `unknown` — spec amendment at wrapup; statuses::cancelled is in-process (daemon has no cancel RPC; disconnect aborts after 300 s).
